recentItems.title: Gold Mahakumbh 2026: Gold's Downside May Be Limited, Says Chirag Sheth | Business News | ET Now
recentItems.description:
Where are gold prices headed amid geopolitical uncertainty, oil-driven inflation and changing expectations around US Federal Reserve policy?

At Gold Mahakumbh, Chirag Sheth of Public Gold Bullion (SG) Pte. Ltd. shares his outlook on the precious metal, suggesting that the downside could be limited to around $100–$200. He also discusses the long-term outlook for gold and the potential support from renewed ETF inflows and physical buying.

Can these factors help gold prices regain momentum? Watch the full discussion for his assessment of the risks and opportunities ahead.

recentItems.title: Ashok Leyland Targets 80% EV Localization By FY30! CEO Reveals Big Expansion Plans | Business News
recentItems.description:
Ashok Leyland Targets 80% EV Localization By FY30! CEO Reveals Big Expansion Plans | Business News Inside Ashok Leyland's new 70-acre manufacturing facility in Lucknow, MD & CEO Shrinu Agarwal reveals the company's next phase of growth, spanning electric vehicles, light commercial vehicles, defence and power solutions. The company plans to invest up to ₹500 crore in the facility, aims for more than 80% EV localization over the next five to six years, and targets doubling its defence business to ₹2,500 crore over the next three years. The CEO also discusses plans to expand LCV market participation and deploy AI to improve truck diagnostics and service efficiency. However, rising commodity costs are putting pressure on margins, with Q3 expected to be more challenging than Q2. recentItems.title: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede Kills 19: SIT Probe Ordered, Arrests Made as BJP-TMC Clash Erupts
recentItems.description:
Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede Kills 19: SIT Probe Ordered, Arrests Made as BJP-TMC Clash Erupts

A stampede at Kolkata’s Chor Bagan Durga Puja pandal killed 19 people, including women and children, triggering a major political row. The West Bengal government has announced an SIT probe, while six people have been arrested. Heavy rain, overcrowding and a warning about the pandal’s collapse are among the factors under investigation.

recentItems.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Case: 3 Suspects Arrested At Kota Railway Station While Travelling By Train
recentItems.description:
Three suspects have been arrested at Rajasthan’s Kota railway station in connection with the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff’s car. They were reportedly travelling by train when they were apprehended.

The incident occurred as Tiger Shroff was leaving a venue in Mumbai’s Juhu area after playing football at Pushpa Park. One of the arrested suspects is reportedly a 17-year-old from Sonipat, Haryana.

Watch for the latest developments in the investigation.
